cancel(uint256).details: Only the owner or avatar can cancel a proposal

params.voteType: The type of vote (No, Yes, Abstain)

params.principal: The member whose merkle leaf supplies voting power.
params.proof: The principal's proof against the proposal-pinned root.
params.reason: Human-readable analysis or rationale, emitted only in the receipt event.
params.votingPower: The principal's power in the proposal-pinned root.

execute(uint256).details: M-4: only after the proposal's snapshotted delay past the voting end — the exit window      between "passed" and "touching the Safe". M-7: execution also has a snapshotted closing      edge. M-8: a failed action REVERTS the whole execution (the proposal stays Passed and      retryable until its deadline) instead of being silently swallowed while marked executed.

returns.proposalState: The current state of the proposal

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proposalExecutionDeadline(uint256).details: Kept as a narrow indexer seam: adding the deadline to Proposal changes its tuple ABI,      while this scalar getter lets consumers adopt the closing edge independently.

params.title: The title of the proposal
params.votingPower: The claimed voting power (for merkle proof verification)

params.title: The title of the proposal
params.voteType: The type of vote to cast (No, Yes, Abstain)
params.votingPower: The claimed voting power (for merkle proof verification)

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAvatar(address).details: Sets the avatar to a new avatar (`newAvatar`).

setTarget(address).details: Sets the target to a new target (`newTarget`).

params.delegate: The delegate, or address(0) to revoke the current delegation.

state(uint256).details: Reverts if proposal does not exist

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

EXECUTION_WINDOW().notice: Number of blocks for which a passed proposal may execute after its exit delay.

MAX_DELEGATE_REASON_BYTES().notice: Maximum UTF-8 byte length of the event-only delegate rationale.

MIN_ACTIVITY_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL().notice: Limits permissionless refresh checkpoints to roughly hourly cadence on mainnet.         A direct vote always checkpoints immediately regardless of this interval.

QUORUM_RANGE().notice: The divisor for quorum calculations (quorum = QUORUM_RANGE = 100% quorum)

activityAccumulator().notice: Hash-chain head and record count for direct, non-delegated governance votes.

activityCheckpointCount().notice: Number of immutable activity checkpoints available to signer proofs.

castVote(uint256,uint8,uint256,bytes32[].notice: Cast a vote with merkle proof verification

castVoteAsDelegate(address,uint256,uint8.notice: Cast a provisional vote for a principal who delegated to the caller.

checkpointSignerActivity().notice: Refresh the block reference used for inactivity without claiming any new account         activity. Permissionless and non-censorable; the accumulator/count stay unchanged.

currentMerkleRoot().notice: Current merkle root for voting power verification

delegateCallAllowlist(address).notice: Targets a proposal action may `DelegateCall` (M-4). A delegatecall executes         arbitrary code IN THE SAFE'S CONTEXT, bypassing any Guard and able to rewrite         module/owner storage — so it is deny-by-default and per-target allowlisted (e.g. a         reviewed MultiSendCallOnly). Checked at BOTH propose and execute time.

delegateVoter(uint256,address).notice: The delegate that cast a proposal's provisional vote (retained after override).

executionDelay().notice: Blocks between a proposal passing (endBlock) and becoming executable (M-4,         2026-08-13 audit). The exit window: a passed-but-hostile proposal cannot reach the         Safe's funds in the same block its voting closes. ~1 day by default; governance can         tune it, but there is deliberately no zero-delay fast path baked in.

getProposal(uint256).notice: Get a proposal with its state and actions

hasVoted(uint256,address).notice: Tracks whether an address has voted on a proposal

initialBindingPublished().notice: Whether the initial snapshot binding has been announced (or superseded by a         rotation). Construction is deliberately SILENT: a streaming indexer discovers this         module from its factory's discovery event, and a constructor log would precede that         event inside the creating block — the exact ordering that wedged the indexer.         `publishInitialSnapshotBinding()` emits the announcement after discovery instead.

ipfsHash().notice: IPFS hash for current merkle root metadata

ipfsHashCid().notice: The optional ipfs hash CID containing metadata about the root (e.g. the merkle tree itself).

merkleSnapshotContract().notice: Address of the MerkleSnapshot contract that can update merkle state

proposalExecutionDeadline(uint256).notice: Read the execution deadline without decoding the full dynamic Proposal tuple.

proposeWithVote(string,string,address[],.notice: Create a new proposal and cast the proposer's vote in one transaction

publishInitialSnapshotBinding().notice: Announce the constructor-bound snapshot to streaming indexers. One-shot and         permissionless, mirroring the typed controllers' `publishInitialVersion()`: the         creating factory calls it AFTER its own discovery event so ordered indexers have         already materialized this module's row when the announcement arrives. A snapshot         rotation supersedes it (rotation makes its own announcement).

setAvatar(address).notice: Can only be called by the current owner.

setDelegateCallTarget(address,bool).notice: Allow or revoke a `DelegateCall` target for proposal actions (M-4).

setExecutionDelay(uint256).notice: Update the execution delay (M-4). Zero is allowed but is an explicit governance         decision to give up the exit window, never a default.

setTarget(address).notice: Can only be called by the current owner.

setUp(bytes).notice: Sets up the module for factory deployment

setVoteDelegate(address).notice: Set or revoke the one account allowed to cast provisional votes for the caller.

state(uint256).notice: Get the state of a proposal

totalVotingPower().notice: Total voting power across all accounts in the merkle tree

voteDelegate(address).notice: The single account allowed to cast provisional votes for each principal.

votePower(uint256,address).notice: Voting power recorded with a vote, needed for exact tally replacement.

votedByDelegate(uint256,address).notice: Whether the recorded vote is provisional because a delegate cast it.

votes(uint256,address).notice: Tracks the vote type for each voter on a proposal
